title: Concept: Lockfile without a lockfile format version
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile that declares no format version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without the version field the installer guesses the format, and different npm releases can resolve different trees from the same file.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: Without the version field the installer guesses the format, and different npm releases can resolve different trees from the same file.
